name: helper-detail-identity
goal: Each helper opens only its own API; naming corrections repair the responsible Harness process

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Cards use only module unit id, while commit 13247fde added every callable contract to that shared page. Requirement: distinct helper addresses and a single selected API, preserving module ownership/history.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing entity-contract and entityPreviewPage asserted multiple callable regions together; card tests checked module addresses only. Extend route, lens, catalog, contract, and standardized browser flows to assert selected callable identity, isolated params/return/errors, missing symbol and revision continuity. Generated guidance tests require semantic naming and causal process correction.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed failing checkpoint a4b9da47; immutable record 24ead97b70e18ceded9ee7221a7c600ff27eb8101031e693aabfd05c5fe2fd41. Root route, generated policy, card/lens/contract tests and standardized browser flow reproduce lost callable identity.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Add helper identity to existing route/query and canonicalization, retain it within entity tabs/history, select only that API in EntityFrame, offer legacy module links and explicit missing helper. Extend shared bugRepairPolicy and local Harness skill with semantic naming and earliest-control diagnosis; generator tests prove tenant guidance propagation.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: 93661d95 adds callable-scoped card URLs, tab/history identity, one-helper contract/header/source projection, missing-helper gaps, canonical query support, local skill and shared tenant/agent naming rules. b111eddf keeps route parsing within lint complexity limits; unchanged root focused tests pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final paired proof: red 78d8b584dcb4530a884aa637fbfc938a49f96b55a83c5e69170f435654225647 at test-only 71a3b3ec; green 60031a326c3fa87c3925f987bff94328f08f199be33feead4be06f3301717c6a at fix 2effd64b. Same frozen inputs, command and environment. Root route/policy, 25 web tests and three browser widths pass.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated 2effd64b snapshot: restoring the old ExplorerFunctionCard causes the unchanged card test to fail; restoring old consoleCanonical causes the unchanged canonical test to fail. Each restored fix passes. /tmp/helper-detail-guard.json records both exit pairs 1 then 0; no working server mutation.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Reports check: 601 unit tests, formatting, Svelte diagnostics, lint, three builds and audit pass. Root focused routes/policy/generator tests: 80 pass; CLI/generator/index integration: 20 pass. Registry: 1308 units, 64 declared uncertainties, zero errors. Recorded browser flow passes at all three widths and current/historical revisions; live 5688 catalog opens separate kebab/Pascal pages, preserves History selection and shows the correct example modal. Fresh 2effd64b screenshots inspected. Full root check passed formatting/types/lint/Rust before being stopped during broader tests to exclude Electron; full repository check is not reported passing.
